_comment: English bodies for strands-agents (framework). Mechanism per C0-1..6. No extraSections in source; sections/sectionTitles omitted. related has 2 entries: one .md link + one plain-text placeholder (Bedrock Agents not yet profiled) — index-aligned with the source 相关条目 list.

axes.model_access: Multi-provider access (Bedrock-first, plus Anthropic/OpenAI/LiteLLM lines — per the official docs, not itemized one by one); the official narrative is "model-driven": in the agent loop the model itself decides which tools to call.
axes.runtime:
Python/TS SDK (installed into your process); GitHub 8,997★, last push 2026-10-29 (API verified).
An AWS open-source line (officially produced, not a hosted service — distinct from the Bedrock Agents hosted line).
axes.local_files:
Library form running inside your process; where data lands is your call. Tool execution (shell/file kinds) happens on your machine —
the permissions surface follows the tools you grant.
axes.background: A library has no resident semantics; whether your agent application stays resident depends on your deployment. The observability line (agent trace export) is in the official docs.
axes.tools:
Tool definition is minimal (decorator style); **MCP support is an explicit official surface** (the MCP client integration sits in the docs mainline) —
one of its differentiators versus most frameworks.
axes.context: A session-memory component is in the official module family (the session-persistence line); cross-session memory gives an interface, not hosting.
axes.permissions:
No account system (library form); the permissions surface = the various vendors' keys you wire in + the tool capabilities you register (including high-risk shell-class tools —
the official docs have a security-guidance line, not itemized).
axes.fit:
Fits: agent development on the AWS stack (Bedrock first-class), wanting explicit MCP client capability, wanting a lightweight SDK rather than a heavy framework.
Does not fit: as the default choice outside AWS stacks (the ecosystem is narrower than LangChain's); wanting visual orchestration (it is code-first).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md).
unknowns:
- The full provider catalog (not itemized one by one)
- Capability details of the MCP client integration (the mainline exists; not itemized)
- Current completeness of the observability/evaluation line (not itemized)
related: Both lightweight official SDKs: the OpenAI version binds shallowly to its own ecosystem; Strands binds deeply to Bedrock. Bedrock Agents / AgentCore (automation category, dossier pending) — same-vendor two-line contrast: hosted vs open-source SDK; tell them apart first when selecting; cross-link once that dossier goes live.
